_comment: Per-model facts for the OpenAI benchmark runners. A model not listed here is an error, never a default. api: chat = Chat Completions, responses = Responses API (the pro and codex models refuse Chat Completions). max_output_tokens: the most the runner may ask for (reasoning included); a larger --max-tokens is lowered to it. service_tiers: the tiers the model was seen to accept (IDEAS.md, tier probe 2026-11-19); 'default' means no service_tier is sent. Only gpt-4o, gpt-4o-mini, the three tier rows and the Responses-only models are measured; rows with a note are assumptions, so correct them when a real run shows otherwise.
